title: Core Components, proxy pattern and Data Layer

deck_context.source_summary: Class 13 of a seven-week AEM Sites course, delivered Wednesday, September 2, 2026. The audience already understands AEM Resources, dialogs, HTL, client libraries and browser evidence. This class connects a project-owned Guide Card proxy to a versioned Core Component implementation and its observable Adobe Client Data Layer contract.
deck_context.core_claim: A safe AEM customization gives the project a stable proxy resource type, delegates to a versioned Core Component, changes only the narrowest necessary extension point and preserves observable runtime contracts.
canonical_facts: Core Components package authoring dialogs, Sling Models, HTL markup, accessibility and client-side behavior as reusable production capabilities.
Public Core Component versions protect existing sites from incompatible implementation changes.
Content should reference a site-specific sling:resourceType rather than a Core Component path directly.
A project proxy owns the author-facing title, component group and policy surface.
sling:resourceSuperType delegates missing scripts and resources to an explicit versioned Core Component parent.
A fully inherited proxy can be almost empty and should not copy product implementation.
Customization options increase in maintenance cost from policy/style through dialog, scoped assets, model delegation and HTL override.
Changing a component super type version is a contract change that can affect authoring, models, markup, CSS hooks, client behavior and Data Layer output.
Core Components integrate with the Adobe Client Data Layer to expose standardized component data and events when enabled.

A proxy customization should preserve inherited identifiers, semantic markup, accessibility, supported Data Layer values and browser-observable behavior unless a requirement deliberately changes them.

slides.title: Core Components are versioned production capabilities.
slides.intent: Establish what the project receives before any custom implementation is considered.
key_points: Tested authoring, Sling Models, HTL, accessibility and client behavior
Public component versions protect existing sites
Policies and the Style System often satisfy variation requirements
Inspect installed version, documented features and rendered contract
Custom code must justify the capability gap

slides.title: A proxy gives the site ownership.
slides.intent: Distinguish the project resource type referenced by content from the reusable product implementation.
key_points: Content references a stable site-specific sling:resourceType
The proxy owns title, component group and policy surface
Sites can evolve independently while sharing implementation
A fully inherited proxy can remain almost empty
The boundary avoids later content refactoring

slides.title: Customize at the narrowest extension point.
slides.intent: Order common extension mechanisms by responsibility and maintenance cost.
key_points: Policy or Style System for allowed options and visual variation
Dialog only for required author input
Scoped CSS before JavaScript
Sling Model delegation for changed data with preserved contract
HTL override only when earlier extension points cannot meet the requirement

slides.title: A version upgrade is a contract change to test.
slides.intent: Connect explicit component versioning to evidence-based upgrades.
key_points: The proxy pins a specific Core Component resource type version
A new parent version can alter authoring, models, markup, CSS hooks, behavior or Data Layer
Compare current and target component documentation
Test configured and empty states across runtime surfaces
Keep the project diff small and responsibility visible

slides.title: Key takeaways
slides.intent: Consolidate the five rules for safe Core Component reuse.
key_points: Verify the existing Core Component capability and version before custom code
Use a project proxy without copying product implementation
Make reuse explicit with sling:resourceSuperType
Customize narrowly and test upgrades as contract changes
Preserve observable markup, accessibility, behavior and Data Layer evidence
